scope: Production native storage on host; actual GUI and reboot tasks are separate required gates
checks: Unchanged IEEE/native disk format checked against independent zlib CRCs
Self-descendant, collision and overlong component refusals perform no writes
One subtree metadata transaction preserves descendant bytes and unrelated prefix neighbors
All 144 I/O acknowledgement points, with ordinary and torn failures, remount as complete old or new subtree
Cancellation aborts unpublished destination data and preserves source bytes
One-page verification is bounded; premature finish and wrong source CRC cannot publish
Verified copy publishes exact bytes only after sealing, readback and source-CRC agreement
Subtree removal preserves similarly prefixed unrelated files
A falsely successful corrupted data write is detected before publication; source remains intact
